messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: runtime-pool-prod - multiple pods CrashLoopBackOff. Alerts: 7/12 pods restarted in the last 6m with SIGSEGV in engine/native/fused_kernel.so. Error rate spike in /v1/generate (500s). See grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/serving/runtime-errors
Maya Chen: Ack. I'm oncall. Starting triage. Which nodes are affected and what's the image tag?
Jin Park: Logs from pod runtime-9f8b show repeated: 
```
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what(): fused kernel: out-of-bounds access
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
#0  0x7f9c8a1b in fused_kernel::run() at fused_kernel.cpp:312
```
Maya Chen: Thanks. Any recent deploys?
DeployBot: Deployment event: runtime-service @ rdt-runtime:v1.15.0 -> rdt-runtime:v1.16.0 rolled at 2026-03-15T02:44:00Z by diego.m.
Priya Rao: Observed pattern: node-gpu-12 showing OOM messages right before segfaults. dmesg snippet: 
```
[ 12345.678901] Out of memory: Killed process 32145 (runtime) total-vm:3150000kB, anon-rss:2800000kB
[ 12345.679002] runtime[32145]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f9c8a1b sp 00007ffd..
```
Priya Rao: Could be memory corruption in new fused kernel path under high token-length workloads.
Sam Ortega: I'm cordoning node-gpu-12 to stop new pods from scheduling: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-12` 
Sam Ortega: Plan: 1) cordon affected nodes 2) drain non-critical pods 3) rollback runtime image for canary 4) set DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 env on runtime to force legacy path while we investigate.
Diego Morales: Kicking off canary rollback to rdt-runtime:v1.15.2 (last known good) for runtime-pool-prod/canary. Will monitor canary for 5m.
DeployBot: Canary rollback started: runtime -> rdt-runtime:v1.15.2 (requested by diego.m).
Maya Chen: Priya, can you confirm which customers saw 500s? Need to assess impact.
Priya Rao: acme-inc and beta-labs show 4xx->5xx jump, ~20% of their requests failing in the last 10m. Hosted free-tier traffic also saw small blip.
Jin Park: Requesting core dumps for further analysis. Commands: 
```
sudo apt-get install -y apport
sudo systemctl enable apport
# on node with crash
coredumpctl dump --output=/tmp/core.runtime.32145
scp /tmp/core.runtime.32145 build:/tmp/ (or upload to s3)
# gdb backtrace
gdb -q /opt/rdt/runtime/bin/engine /tmp/core.runtime.32145 -ex 'thread apply all bt' -ex quit
```
Diego Morales: Capturing cores now, copying to s3://rd-incident-archives/1765432100/cores/. Will tag with pod + node.
Sam Ortega: Rolling restart initiated across non-cordoned nodes to clear any tainted state: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-service --namespace=prod --timeout=10m`
Maya Chen: Canary looks good after rollback? Priya?
Priya Rao: Canary (2 pods) on v1.15.2 steady for 3m, no segfaults. Error rate on canary route back to baseline. Global error rate dropping from 8%->1.2% after rollback and env change.
Jin Park: I pulled one core, ran gdb backtrace. Top frame shows null pointer deref in fused_kernel.cpp when sequence length > 4096 and kv-cache resizing path triggered. Attaching essential snippet: `#0 fused_kernel::run() fused_kernel.cpp:312`
Maya Chen: Good. Next steps: keep rollback for prod and disable fused kernels cluster-wide while we patch. Create incident ticket and notify SEs for affected customers.
Diego Morales: Done. Rolling rollback to v1.15.2 for 10/12 pods now. Remaining two are on cordoned node-gpu-12 which I can't schedule onto; will migrate after drain.
DeployBot: Rollback rollout status: 10/12 updated, 2 pending (node-gpu-12).
Priya Rao: Quick mitigation note for customers: we can route acme-inc to dedicated pool on older runtime image manually if they need zero-impact.
Maya Chen: Documenting: INC-20260315-42 created, severity P1 due to customer impact. Linking to runbook: https://wiki.redwood.local/incidents/INC-20260315-42
Jin Park: Action items for postmortem: - add guard for kv-cache resize in fused kernel - add unit tests for sequence length > 4096 - add integration test that runs through fused path under memory pressure - add automatic rollback on >5% 5xx in 3m
Diego Morales: Will prepare hotfix branch that adds bounds check and fallback. CI build and canary patch targeted for 2026-03-15T05:00Z.
Sam Ortega: Handing off pager to Diego in 30m. Notes to next oncall: rollback in place, cores uploaded, canary stable, node-gpu-12 drained and under investigation.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll stay until stabilization confirmed. If error rate stays <2% for 30m we'll start post-incident review.
IncidentBot: Reminder: next oncall rotation: diego.m takes pager at 1765433900.
Priya Rao: Monitoring shows error rate at 0.9% now, acme-inc failures down to 1%.
Diego Morales: Confirmed cores uploaded, logs and s3 paths posted in INC ticket. Starting work on patch.
Maya Chen: Closing on-call for initial mitigation, keeping incident open for root cause and patch work. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
